hubTrigger.claim: 5G commercial licenses were formally issued earlier than the prior common expectation of later 2019, accelerating deployment timing.

candidate.name: 沪电股份

preEventEvidence.claim: 5G products completed most technical certifications in 2018, participated in global trial networks, key Sub-6GHz/mmWave/AAU PCB technologies were mature and capable of batch delivery; company was preparing for the 2019 5G buildout peak.
2019Q1 attributable profit expected RMB140-170m, +99.5% to +142.2%, with revenue and gross margin expected to improve.

emergingPoolCase: 5G PCB was a new high-end growth stream inside a broader enterprise-communications/automotive PCB company rather than the whole legacy business.
Technology qualification and batch-delivery readiness existed before licensing, so the license can accelerate conversion rather than initiate speculative R&D.
The regulatory timing surprise potentially raises the near-term materiality of a previously smaller 5G revenue pool.
risks: Q1 profit improvement also reflects broader product mix and operational efficiency
license issuance does not equal immediate carrier capex/orders

nextGate: freeze price absorption and expectation burden at 2019-06-07
